title: Collection Reversals and Fee Credits on Contingency Placement Agreements
content:
When a payment Ridgeline collected under one of the Contingency Placement Agreements is returned, or part of it is refunded to the consumer as an overpayment, the same amount is reversed out of the client's trust balance against the original collection.

## Credit of the fee on a reversed collection

- The fee on a reversed collection is credited back: as a reversed-collection fee credit against the fees owed for a gross-remittance agreement, and by reducing the next period's retained fees for a net-remittance agreement.
- A reversed-collection credit is issued only when the handling date is no later than the fee credit window counted from the reversal's date.
- The fee credit window is the tier's fee credit window in calendar days, the day after the reversal's date being day one and the last day included. The reversal's date is read from the reversal entry in the agreement's client money history, matched on the collection it reverses.
- Each reversed collection receives at most one reversed-collection credit.

## Other credits

| Credit | Issued for |
|---|---|
| Billing error | correcting a fee line the client disputed within the fee dispute window |
| Recall fee waived | reversing a recall fee charged on a recall that qualified as free |
| Volume rebate | at the tier review, when the agreement's trailing collections exceed the tier's volume rebate threshold: the tier's volume rebate percent of the contingency fees billed in the review year |

The agreement's trailing collections are the collections booked on the agreement less the collections reversed on the agreement, by the date of each entry, in the rolling 365 calendar days ending on the review date, both ends included.

## Hypothetical boundary cases

Under a tier with a fee credit window of 90 calendar days, a reversal dated on day R:

| Handling date | Inside the window? | Reversed-collection credit |
|---|---|---|
| day R plus 1 | yes (day one) | may be issued |
| day R plus 90 | yes (last day, included) | may be issued |
| day R plus 91 | no | not issued |

A collection already carrying a reversed-collection credit receives no second one.

**Hypothetical rebate.** Under a tier with a threshold of 500000.00 USD and a rebate of 1.0 percent, trailing collections of 600000.00 USD exceed the threshold; with contingency fees of 90000.00 USD billed in the review year, the volume rebate credit is 900.00 USD. Trailing collections of exactly 500000.00 USD do not exceed the threshold.
